english.title: Failure to comply with implementation of warrant issued under section 41 - Investigatory Powers Act 2016
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being a relevant operator that had been served with a copy of a,

(A)_[targeted interception]_
(B)_[mutual assistance]_

warrant under section 41 of the Investigatory Powers Act 2016 by or on behalf of the intercepting authority, knowingly failed to take all steps for giving effect to the warrant that were notified to you by or on behalf of that authority
english.legislation: Contrary to section 43(7) of the Investigatory Powers Act 2016.
english.pointstoprove:
date and Location
being a relevant operator in or outside the UK
knowingly failed to give effect to a warrant under section 41 of the Investigatory Powers Act served upon them

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) This offence applies whether or not the relevant operator is in the United Kingdom.
(ii) The duty imposed by section 43(1) is enforceable (whether or not the person is in the United Kingdom) by civil proceedings by the Secretary of State for an injunction, or for specific performance of a statutory duty under section 45 of the Court of Session Act 1988, or for any other appropriate relief.
(iii) See subsection 43(2) for the definition of "relevant operator" and section 41 for the meaning of "intercepting authority".
(iv) See also subsections 43(5) and (6) in relation to what is deemed "reasonably practicable" and regarding obligations that have been imposed under section 253.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: 12 months imprisonment and / or a fine.
INDICTMENT: 2 years imprisonment and / or a fine.Note:
In relation to an offence committed before paragraph 24(2) of Schedule 22 to the Sentencing Act 2020 comes into force (01/12/20), the reference to 12 months imprisonment in relation to summary offences, above, is to be read as a reference to 6 months imprisonment.
